title: Standard Operating Procedure - Electronics Return
content: Electronics returns are valid for 14 days from delivery date. Items must have original seal intact. Claims above ₹5,000 require proof of purchase.

title: Logistics & Shipping Policy
content: Deliveries across India are fulfilled via BlueDart and Delhivery. Standard transit timeline is 3 to 5 business days.

title: Warranty Service Terms
content: Standard hardware warranty covers manufacturing defects for 90 days. Accidental liquid damage is excluded unless covered by Extended Care.
